jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BETTERUP

Let’s face it, a company whose mission is human transformation better have some fresh thinking about the employer/employee relationship.

 

We do. We can’t cram it all in here, but you’ll start noticing it from the first interview.

 

Even our candidate experience is different. And when you get an offer from us (and accept it), you get way more than a paycheck. You get a personal BetterUp Coach, a development plan, a trained and coached manager, the most amazing team you’ve ever met, and most importantly, work that matters.

This makes for a remarkably focused and fulfilling work experience. Frankly, it’s not for everyone. But for people with fire in their belly, it’s a game-changing, career-defining, soul-lifting move.

 

Join us and we promise you the most intense and fulfilling years of your career, doing life-changing work in a fun, inventive, soulful culture.

 

We are a hybrid company with a focus on in-person collaboration when necessary. Employees are expected to be available to work from one of our office hubs at least two days per week, or eight days per month. Our US hub locations include: Austin, TX; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; and the Washington, DC metro area. Please ensure you can realistically commit to this structure before applying.




ROLE OVERVIEW



BetterUp is seeking a Senior Sales & Strategy Analytics Manager to own forecasting, pipeline analytics, and planning support for our GTM organization. Reporting into GTM Operations, you'll be the analytical backbone for how leadership understands business performance — turning pipeline and revenue data into the insights that shape strategy, resourcing, and board-level reporting. This is a backfill for a tenured member of the team, stepping into an established function with high executive visibility.



What you'll do:



 - Own end-to-end forecasting and pipeline analytics, delivering the reporting GTM leadership and the board rely on for planning

 - Lead annual and mid-year planning cycles in partnership with Sales and RevOps leadership — capacity modeling, territory design, and quota setting

 - Architect domain-level reinvention of forecasting and reporting processes: identify the highest-leverage automation and analytics opportunities, secure resourcing to test them, and install repeatable mechanisms that scale across teams

 - Serve as a trusted analytical partner to our Executive Leadership and in particular, our President and Sales Leader, translating complex pipeline and revenue data into clear, decision-ready narratives

 - Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Sales, and GTM Systems to keep forecasting methodology, data definitions, and business intelligence reporting aligned and trustworthy

 - Mentor and upskill teammates on analytical rigor and forecasting best practices

 - Continuously reinvent the function using AI and new technologies as they arise
   
   - E.g. -  Develop an accurate forecasting model taking into account structured and unstructured data elements
   
   - E.g. -  Automate commission process and dispute resolution
   
   - E.g. - Create tools to self-serve data and insights using natural language



If you have some or all of the following, please apply:



 - 8+ years of experience in sales/revenue operations, FP&A, or GTM analytics, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Have built organization or team-wide AI tools to increase efficiencies or effectiveness of revenue operations processes

 - Deep experience with forecasting methodology, pipeline analytics, and board/ELT-level reporting

 - Strong command of Salesforce and BI tooling

 - Proven ability to lead planning cycles (capacity, territory, quota) cross-functionally with Sales and Finance

 - Serves as a trusted advisor to Executive leadership spanning Finance, Sales and Executive Office



Preferred Qualifications:



 - Background in a startup/hyper-growth environment with evolving GTM motion

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong, and other GTM systems



Location & Work Arrangement:

- Hub-based, 2 days/week minimum — Austin, NYC, San Francisco, or Arlington VA metro



This role is open to candidates across the US. Please review the above carefully and ensure the applicable model works for your situation before applying.

The base salary range for this role is as follows:

$160,000 – $220,00 USD: New York City and San Francisco

$144,000 – $198,000 USD: All other US locations



AI at BetterUp



Our team thrives at the intersection of human expertise and AI capability. As an AI-forward company, adaptation and continuous learning are part of our daily work. We're looking for teammates who are excited to evolve alongside technology – people who experiment boldly, share their discoveries openly, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work. These professionals thoughtfully integrate AI into their work to deliver exceptional results while maintaining the human judgment and creativity that drives real innovation. During our interview process, you'll have opportunities to showcase how you harness AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact.



Benefits:



At BetterUp, we are committed to living out our mission every day and that starts with providing benefits that allow our employees to care for themselves, support their families, and give back to their community.



- Access to BetterUp coaching; one for you and one for a friend or family member

- A competitive compensation plan with opportunity for advancement

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Flexible paid time off

- Per year:

  - All federal/statutory holidays observed

  - 4 BetterUp Inner Workdays (https://www.betterup.co/inner-work)

  - 5 Volunteer Days to give back

  - Company wide Summer & Winter breaks

- Year-round charitable contribution of your choice on behalf of BetterUp

- 401(k) self contribution



We are dedicated to building diverse teams that fuel an authentic workplace and sense of belonging for each and every employee. We know applying for a job can be intimidating, please don't hesitate to reach out — we encourage everyone interested in joining us to apply.



BetterUp Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, BetterUp Inc. complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Partnerships Manager, GTM
jobs.description:
Senior Channel Partnerships Manager, Go-to-Market



Let's face it, a company whose mission is human transformation better have some fresh thinking about the employer/employee relationship.



We do. We can't cram it all in here, but you'll start noticing it from the first interview.



Even our candidate experience is different. And when you get an offer from us (and accept it), you get way more than a paycheck. You get a personal BetterUp Coach, a development plan, a trained and coached manager, the most amazing team you've ever met (yes, each with their own personal BetterUp Coach), and most importantly, work that matters.



This makes for a remarkably focused and fulfilling work experience. Frankly, it's not for everyone. But for people with fire in their belly, it's a game-changing, career-defining, soul-lifting move.



Join us and we promise you the most intense and fulfilling years of your career, doing life-changing work in a fun, inventive, soulful culture.



If that sounds exciting—and the job description below feels like a fit—we really should start talking.




The Opportunity

BetterUp is building its Channel partnership motion from the ground up — starting with strategic technology partners like Workday, SAP, Microsoft, Google. This role is responsible for building that function from the ground up: standing up the partner strategy, processes, and relationships where none exist today, and turning them into a repeatable go-to-market motion that drives the pipeline. This is a backfill role reporting to the SVP, Channel Partnerships.



What you'll do:

- Partner strategy: Own strategic partnerships across HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP), technology platforms (e.g., Google, Microsoft), consulting firms, and global systems integrators, from origination through launch.

- Program build: Build the partner program from the ground up, including partner selection criteria, engagement processes, and operating structure where none currently exist.

- Executive relationships: Build executive relationships with partner leadership focused on long-term business value.

- Business planning: Define joint business plans with measurable goals for pipeline, revenue, and market expansion.

- Go-to-market: Lead go-to-market planning for new product launches into the partner ecosystem, and build co-sell motions that bring partners into the sales cycle earlier.

- Sales alignment: Work with Sales to embed partners into account planning and strategic pursuits.

- Marketing alignment: Work with Marketing and Product Marketing on joint messaging, case studies, and campaign assets.

- Enablement: Build partner enablement programs so partner sales teams can represent BetterUp accurately and confidently.

- Operating cadence: Run recurring partner operating cadences, including executive business reviews and quarterly planning.

- Feedback loop: Surface partner feedback and ecosystem trends to leadership on a regular basis.

- Cross-functional work: Partner with Product, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to resolve partner issues and translate partner input into product and GTM decisions.

- Measurement: Define and track metrics for partner health, including partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue, and executive engagement, and assess where BetterUp should invest further.



If you have some or all of the following, please apply:

- 6+ years of experience managing technology partnerships or channel go-to-market motions.

- Experience building and managing relationships with senior and C-level executives at partner companies.

- Experience launching partner go-to-market programs, including co-sell motions and joint account planning.

- Experience working cross-functionally across sales, marketing, product, and operations.

- Drives functional strategy for AI adoption, identifying transformational opportunities that create competitive advantage.

- Transforms core business processes through strategic AI integration (e.g., marketing automation, sales intelligence, operations efficiency).



Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience partnering with major technology platforms (e.g., Google, Microsoft, Workday, SAP).

- Experience in the HR technology or workforce transformation space.

- Experience building partner enablement programs from the ground up.



Reporting & Team Structure:

- Reports to: SVP, Channel Partnerships

- Direct reports: None



Hybrid Work Policy & Hub Locations
BetterUp is a hybrid company that values in-person collaboration. Our US hub locations include: Austin, TX; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; and the Arlington, VA.

 - Hybrid Expectation: You will be expected to work from your local office at least 2 days per week (or 8 days per month) and should be able to realistically commit to this structure before applying. This hybrid role will require travel up to 25% of the time for client engagements.

 - If you are not located near a hub: You will work as a fully remote employee. This remote role will require travel up to 50% of the time for client engagements and internal BetterUp purposes.


This role is open to candidates across the US. Please review the above carefully and ensure the applicable model works for your situation before applying.

The base salary range for this role is as follows:

$160,000 – $200,00 USD: New York City and San Francisco

$144,000 – $180,000 USD: All other US locations

 

Benefits:

At BetterUp, we are committed to living out our mission every day and that starts with providing benefits that allow our employees to care for themselves, support their families, and give back to their community.

- Access to BetterUp coaching; one for you and one for a friend or family member

- A competitive compensation plan with opportunity for advancement

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Flexible paid time off

- Per year:

  - All federal/statutory holidays observed

  - 4 BetterUp Inner Workdays (https://www.betterup.co/inner-work)

  - 5 Volunteer Days to give back

  - Learning and Development stipend

  - Company wide Summer & Winter breaks

- Year-round charitable contribution of your choice on behalf of BetterUp

- 401(k) self contribution





AI at BetterUp

Our team thrives at the intersection of human expertise and AI capability. As an AI-forward company, adaptation and continuous learning are part of our daily work. We're looking for teammates who are excited to evolve alongside technology – people who experiment boldly, share their discoveries openly, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work. These professionals thoughtfully integrate AI into their work to deliver exceptional results while maintaining the human judgment and creativity that drives real innovation. During our interview process, you’ll have opportunities to showcase how you harness AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact.

jobs.title: HR Operations & AI Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BETTERUP

Let’s face it, a company whose mission is human transformation better have some fresh thinking about the employer/employee relationship.



We do. We can’t cram it all in here, but you’ll start noticing it from the first interview.



Even our candidate experience is different. And when you get an offer from us (and accept it), you get way more than a paycheck. You get a personal BetterUp Coach, a development plan, a trained and coached manager, the most amazing team you’ve ever met, and most importantly, work that matters.

This makes for a remarkably focused and fulfilling work experience. Frankly, it’s not for everyone. But for people with fire in their belly, it’s a game-changing, career-defining, soul-lifting move.



Join us and we promise you the most intense and fulfilling years of your career, doing life-changing work in a fun, inventive, soulful culture.



We are a hybrid company with a focus on in-person collaboration when necessary. Employees are expected to be available to work from one of our office hubs at least two days per week, or eight days per month. Our US hub locations include: Austin, TX; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; and the Washington, DC metro area. Please ensure you can realistically commit to this structure before applying.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for an HR Operations & AI Enablement Manager to reimagine how HR Operations works at BetterUp. You'll own the operational backbone of the HR function (the processes, systems partnership, and compliance work that make every employee interaction reliable, fast, and consistent) and you'll use AI and automation to remove as much manual work from it as possible.

You'll lead and develop a team of three to five, act as the escalation point for complex employee issues, and be the connective tissue between HR Ops, Legal, Payroll, IT, Recruiting, Total Rewards, and our Workday and AI Automation engineers. You'll also pilot lightweight fixes yourself and partner with engineers when something needs real build work.



This is a high-impact role for someone who has run and scaled HR operations before, thinks in systems, measures what they ship, and wants to bring that judgment to a team that is still building its playbook.



This role reports to the VP of Total Rewards and HR Operations, and manages a team of 3-5.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




AI & AUTOMATION ENABLEMENT

 - Bring an AI-first lens to HR Ops: identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone work and either fix it directly with lightweight tools or scope it for the AI Automation Engineer

 - Redesign end-to-end HR Ops workflows (such as onboarding and offboarding) with automation and AI embedded where they create real leverage, not novelty for its own sake

 - Pilot and evaluate emerging AI tools relevant to HR Ops (for example AI-assisted case triage, employee-facing Q&A, and agents), and build the case for what is worth scaling

 - Define and report the impact of what we ship: hours saved, cycle time reduced, errors prevented, employee experience improved

 - Act as HR Ops' go-to resource for "can we automate this," partnering with the AI Automation Engineer for anything that needs custom code

 - Coach the team to adopt AI tools and build their own automation habits

 - Establish practical governance and best practices for responsible AI use in HR Ops, including data privacy and employee information




HR OPERATIONS & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Lead and continuously improve end-to-end HR processes (onboarding, offboarding, benefits administration, leave management, and employee records) with clear SLAs and consistent execution

 - Solve problems at the root cause and across the whole People function, so fixes work for Recruiting, HR Business Partners, Compensation, and Benefits, not just for HR Ops

 - Own HR case management and employee support processes, serving as the escalation point for complex or ambiguous issues

 - Ensure HR policies and procedures are clearly documented, consistently applied, and aligned with compliance requirements

 - Administer and oversee benefits operations, working with the VP of Total Rewards and HR Operations on strategy




SYSTEMS PARTNERSHIP & DATA

 - Represent HR Ops' needs in the Workday and People Technology roadmap: define requirements, test changes, and drive adoption, without owning system configuration directly

 - Own HR data integrity and reporting accuracy within HR Ops' processes, and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations

 - Partner with the Workday Engineer, AI Automation Engineer, and IT to troubleshoot process-level issues and scope enhancements

 - Help build BetterUp's HR analytics capability, turning HR Ops data into insight and not just process exhaust




COMPLIANCE & RISK MANAGEMENT

 - Ensure HR Ops practices comply with employment laws, data privacy regulations, and HR best practices across the jurisdictions BetterUp operates in

 - Maintain HR documentation and records to legal and company standards

 - Lead or support HR audits, compliance reporting, and policy updates, and stay proactive rather than reactive




PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Manage and develop the HR Ops team: let them run their domains, hold them accountable for outcomes, and push their thinking toward end-to-end process design

 - Serve as a thought partner to senior HR, Legal, Payroll, and IT stakeholders, keeping HR Ops aligned with business objectives

 - Partner with the HRBP team on complex employee inquiries involving payroll, benefits, or policy interpretation

 - Own vendor and third-party relationships for HR Ops tools and services: contract accuracy, cost-effectiveness, and strategic fit





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Manual, repetitive HR Ops work is measurably reduced through automation and AI, and we can show the numbers

 - HR Ops processes run against clear, documented SLAs with consistent execution across onboarding, off-boarding, and case management

 - Recurring problems are solved at the root instead of resolved ticket by ticket

 - The HR Ops team is well-managed, growing, and able to handle complex employee situations independently

 - Compliance and audit readiness are maintained proactively

 - HR Ops requirements are well represented in the Workday and People Technology roadmap

 - Early HR analytics capability exists where none did before

 - HR Ops is seen across the company as a credible, reliable partner




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

You must bring the following to be considered for this role:

 - 6+ years of experience in HR operations, HRIS, or related HR leadership, including proven experience scaling HR processes, systems, and compliance in a fast-growing company

 - Hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve HR operations (for example automating workflows, improving reporting, or enhancing employee experience), with specific examples of measured impact, and the ability to coach a team to adopt these tools

 - Experience administering or managing benefits, with a working understanding of compliance requirements

 - Direct experience with Workday and connecting it to other systems (for example Pave, Ashby, HC 365, Athena). You understand how the tools fit together even if you don't configure them yourself

 - A track record of running HR operations work end to end: solving ambiguous, cross-functional problems at the root rather than escalating them away

 - Experience managing a team and building a high-performance culture, including coaching team members at different stages of their development, ideally a team that is still developing its skills and needs active coaching

 - Experience with global HR operations and compliance across multiple jurisdictions

 - A data-driven mindset, with experience in HR reporting and analytics and in defining and tracking success metrics





IF YOU HAVE SOME OR ALL OF THE FOLLOWING, PLEASE APPLY


HR OPS & SYSTEMS FLUENCY

 - Experience having led systems integration or new-system rollouts within an organization

 - Experience designing shared-services thinking — defining what HR information should be self-service vs. accessible to which parts of the business

 - Comfort partnering with engineers (rather than owning the build yourself) to translate HR Ops needs into system requirements


AI & AUTOMATION

 - Experience piloting or leading AI tooling adoption for an HR or operations team (e.g., AI-assisted case triage, employee Q&A bots)

 - A builder mentality: you ship small, instrument what you build, and iterate based on real usage


SCALE & LEADERSHIP

 - Experience in a larger or more mature HR organization than BetterUp’s current size, with a track record of helping a function scale and operationalize

 - Background in tech or high-growth startups

 - Benefits administration experience

 - HR certifications (e.g., SPHR, SHRM-SCP) are a nice to have



Benefits:

At BetterUp, we are committed to living out our mission every day and that starts with providing benefits that allow our employees to care for themselves, support their families, and give back to their community.

- Access to BetterUp coaching; one for you and one for a friend or family member

- A competitive compensation plan with opportunity for advancement

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Flexible paid time off

- Per year:

- All federal/statutory holidays observed

- 4 BetterUp Inner Workdays (https://www.betterup.co/inner-work)

- 5 Volunteer Days to give back

- Company wide Summer & Winter breaks

- Year-round charitable contribution of your choice on behalf of BetterUp

- 401(k) self contribution



This role is open to candidates across the US. Please review the above carefully and ensure the applicable model works for your situation before applying.

The base salary range for this role is as follows:

$168,000 – $250,00 USD: New York City and San Francisco

$151,000 – $226,000 USD: All other US locations




AI AT BETTERUP

Our team thrives at the intersection of human expertise and AI capability. As an AI-forward company, adaptation and continuous learning are part of our daily work. We’re looking for teammates who are excited to evolve alongside technology — people who experiment boldly, share their discoveries openly, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work.

As an HR Operations & AI Enablement Manager, you’ll be expected to:

 - Anticipate industry-shifting AI capabilities and position BetterUp’s HR Operation function to leverage them ahead of competitors

 - Lead enterprise-wide AI transformation initiatives within Total Rewards and HR Operation and the broader People and Community team

 - Drive functional strategy for AI adoption, identifying transformational opportunities that create competitive advantage in how we manage the employee lifecycle

 - Build scalable AI-powered systems that fundamentally change how work gets done across multiple teams

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on AI capabilities, limitations, and strategic implications for the People function

 - Establish governance frameworks and best practices for responsible AI usage across recruiting workflows at scale



During our interview process, you’ll have opportunities to showcase how you harness AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact.


This role is open to candidates across the US. Please review the above carefully and ensure the applicable model works for your situation before applying.
